observation.command: pkill -f "python3 -m http.server 8081"; WPIDS=$(ps aux | grep -E 'webpack|npm start|node .*webpack' | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2}'); echo "webpack pids: $WPIDS"; for p in $WPIDS; do kill $p 2>/dev/null; done; sleep 3; ps aux | grep -E 'webpack|http.server' | grep -v grep; echo "---ports after cleanup---"; for f in /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6; do [ -f "$f" ] && awk 'NR>1 && $4=="0A" {split($2,a,":"); printf "%d\n", ("0x" a[2])+0}' "$f"; done | sort -un; echo "done"
